verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains only API technical documentation (SDKs, rate limits, streaming, function calling) and community commentary on model quality/censorship, but no usage policy, terms of service, prohibited-use list, commercial licensing terms, or data-handling commitments are cited. Community comments raise data-privacy concerns (e.g., prompts used for training, data going to China) but these are complaints, not evidence of a clear published policy.
